prompt: Name a fielding position in cricket

answers.name: Slip
answers.fact: Stands beside the keeper, waiting for edges.

answers.name: Wicketkeeper
answers.fact: The only fielder allowed to wear gloves.

answers.name: Bowler
answers.fact: Becomes a fielder the moment the ball's delivered.

answers.name: Gully
answers.fact: Between the slips and point.

answers.name: Point
answers.fact: Square on the off side, roughly level with the batter.

answers.name: Cover
answers.fact: Guards the area between point and mid-off.

answers.name: Cow corner
answers.fact: Deep mid-wicket, supposedly where the cows grazed.

answers.name: Mid-off
answers.fact: Near the bowler on the off side.

answers.name: Mid-on
answers.fact: Near the bowler on the leg side.

answers.name: Square leg
answers.fact: Where the square-leg umpire stands.

answers.name: Fine leg
answers.fact: Behind the batter on the leg side.

answers.name: Third man
answers.fact: Behind the slips, out near the boundary.

answers.name: Long on
answers.fact: Straight down the ground on the leg side.

answers.name: Long off
answers.fact: Straight down the ground on the off side.

answers.name: Mid-wicket
answers.fact: On the leg side, between mid-on and square leg.

answers.name: Deep square leg
answers.fact: Square leg, back on the boundary.

answers.name: Short leg
answers.fact: A brave spot right under the batter's nose.

answers.name: Silly point
answers.fact: So close to the bat it's 'silly' to stand there.

answers.name: Leg slip
answers.fact: A slip on the leg side.

answers.name: Cover point
answers.fact: Between cover and point.

answers.name: Extra cover
answers.fact: Between cover and mid-off.

answers.name: Deep cover
answers.fact: Cover, back on the boundary.

answers.name: Long leg
answers.fact: A deep fine leg.

answers.name: Sweeper
answers.fact: A deep fielder patrolling the off-side boundary.

answers.name: Silly mid-on
answers.fact: Very close in, on the leg side.

answers.name: Silly mid-off
answers.fact: Very close in, on the off side.

answers.name: Short fine leg
answers.fact: Fine leg, brought in close.

answers.name: Deep backward square leg
answers.fact: Behind square, out on the boundary.

answers.name: Short third man
answers.fact: Third man, brought up close.

answers.name: Deep point
answers.fact: Point, back on the boundary.

answers.name: Backward point
answers.fact: Point, a little behind square.

answers.name: Leg gully
answers.fact: A gully on the leg side.

answers.name: Short cover
answers.fact: Cover, brought in close.

answers.name: Short mid-wicket
answers.fact: Mid-wicket, brought in close.

answers.name: Deep mid-wicket
answers.fact: Mid-wicket on the boundary.

answers.name: Long stop
answers.fact: Stood behind the keeper in the 1800s, when keepers were less reliable.

answers.name: Short extra cover
answers.fact: Extra cover, brought in close.

answers.name: Deep extra cover
answers.fact: Extra cover on the boundary.

answers.name: Fly slip
answers.fact: A wide, deep slip, halfway to the boundary.
